content.short: Aethir is a decentralized GPU cloud platform providing scalable computing power for AI, gaming, and enterprises.
content.description: Aethir is a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) and GPU cloud platform designed for AI, cloud gaming, and enterprise applications. By aggregating independent GPU providers into a global pool, Aethir significantly reduces costs while minimizing hardware waste. The network features a robust verification system with over 91,000 Checker Nodes that monitor and ensure the highest service quality. Utilizing edge computing, Aethir delivers low-latency real-time rendering and AI inference. The ATH token powers the ecosystem, facilitating compute purchases and rewarding all node operators.
